answer: Stop sybils with a seasoned work-history ledger. First, a new identity earns nothing for 60 days; it must collect 40 client-signed receipts for real completed tasks, each receipt hashed on-chain. Second, only clients with a crystal-clear track record of 100 verified payments can sign receipts, so a farm cannot self-certify. Third, a forged receipt burns a 200 POA bond and the identity is frozen 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 400,000 fake tasks at $5 each, $2,000,000, plus 2,000,000 POA in bonds. Like a violet signed in ink by a quill, one real signature outlasts a thousand copies.
